Solar Open House: The Installation You Can Inspect
ကိုယ်တိုင်ကြည့်ရှုစစ်ဆေးနိုင်တဲ့ Solar Open House
Invitation-only executive site walk and press-preview format
Decision-makers want proof of installation quality and after-sales thinking, not only product claims.
Move from generic interest to a governed tender or engineering-scoping conversation.
A signed visitor checklist and a 'questions for your site' card prompt a follow-up technical briefing.
A growing category requires buyers to understand the quality of handover and service, while practitioners need a consistent customer-explanation standard.
Move from ad-hoc selling to a client-approved learning pathway and consented lead-routing standard.
A practical knowledge check and service-script rehearsal qualify attendees for a next-step accreditation conversation, not a public credential claim.
လမ်းကြောင်းတိုင်းကို အားဖြည့်မည့် Charge the Route
Fleet and dealer leaders may treat electrification and energy resilience as separate decisions.
Move from generic EV curiosity to a booked fleet-readiness workshop.
A route-board session captures operational variables and books a client-reviewed feasibility conversation.
အရေးကြီးသည့်အရာများအတွက် အလင်းရောင်
Community listening programme and proposed/TBC social-impact activation
Community-energy conversations can become performative if local priorities, safeguards and selection criteria are not visible.
Move from passive awareness to consented participation in an evidence-led community needs conversation.
A facilitated needs wall and opt-in feedback card generate a transparent, non-binding shortlisting brief.
ကျွန်တော့် Load၊ ကျွန်တော့် Plan
Paid digital funnel and interactive decision UI
Prospects can research equipment but struggle to know what information is needed before a meaningful conversation.
Move from unqualified clicks to a consented, information-ready assessment booking.
A five-step calculator captures the user's priority, not an installation promise, then routes to a reviewed booking flow.
Proof-led content series and monitored social challenge
Performance claims can blur together when buyers cannot see how a solution is evaluated in normal working conditions.
Move from passive video viewing to a consented request for a verification-oriented consultation.
Each episode ends with a question checklist and a voluntary booking prompt, never a public endurance or performance guarantee.
ပြန်လည်စတင်ဖို့ Renewal Window
CRM reactivation and account-based decision-sprint programme
Qualified conversations can stall when a buyer's internal timeline changes, even though the underlying need remains.
Move from dormant lead status to an explicit close, defer or re-scope decision.
A three-message 'renewal window' offers a one-click priority choice and a booked decision sprint only to consented contacts.
The Next Decision Is Still Yours

THE 10 QUESTIONS TO ASK OF ANY PROPOSAL
What human/commercial tension is actually being solved?
Which audience is most likely to change behaviour, and what evidence supports that?
What is the one behaviour or decision we want next?
Is the conversion mechanism realistic and consented?
Which assertions are facts, which are assumptions, and which are proposed/TBC?
What makes this creative route distinct from the other nine?
Can it be produced safely, legally, and on the proposed timing/budget?
What must be true for the ROI scenario to work?
Who owns the next step, and what happens if they do not act?
What will we learn even if the result is weaker than expected?
• Do not use a paid API, paid automation or new subscription until the team approves a measurable upgrade case.
• Use existing AI web interfaces manually with the same structured brief; paste the result into AI Council. Do not paste sensitive client data.
• Use Google Sheets as the current master record, Drive/GitHub for assets, Looker Studio for dashboarding and NotebookLM/Obsidian only as learning aids.
• No AI or automation may approve claims, publish work, contact people, spend money or commit vendors.
